- `satori.reminder()` → `{ supported, on, minute, note }`: whether this browser can take the daily reminder, whether it
  is on, its time (`minute` of the local day, or null), and why not (`note`).
- `await satori.remindMe()` → `{ at }` (only on the person's request; asks for notification permission): the Game's Sent
  screen's Remind me, one notification at `game().opensAt` (unix seconds), daily reminder on or not. Throws when this
  round wasn't played with the game, or as `setReminder` does.
- `await satori.setBaseMaxFee(gwei)` → `base()` (only on the person's
  request): the most any transaction pays per gas, the batch's and the
  wallet's (a positive number; `''` or null = 2 gwei). Settings saves both at
  once and checks both before saving either.

Errors are thrown as `Error` with a readable message (for example
`Wrong passphrase`, `Unlock the wallet first`). Central's errors are not
thrown: they are in `status().central` (for example `Satori Service 500:
…`, `Satori Service unreachable: Failed to fetch`, `Satori Service timed
out (15 s)`). An error's text is data: it may quote what a server said.

## Drive it from the UI

- **Setup**: "Create a wallet" (shows the wallet's 24 words, asks for
  three of them, then a passphrase), "Import" (the wallet's words or
  private key), or "Import
  Docker files" ("Wallet file": `wallet.yaml`, or `vault.yaml` from an older
  install; the wallet password, and
  "Use it as this app's passphrase too", ticked: when the Docker password is
  shorter than 8 characters, or unticked, the passphrase step asks for a new
  one). A wallet file that is not encrypted (the alias file), a file over 64 KB
  or one that is not YAML are refused with a message saying so. The keys are stored in
  this app's own format; the files are not kept. On a first visit Setup
  shows at once while the engine downloads ("Finishing setup… downloading
  the engine, 2.5 of 5.1 MB", `setup-wait`).
- **Other screens**: "Unlock to finish the update" (`finish`: "Wallet
  passphrase to finish the update", Unlock); "Satori is open in another tab"
  (`elsewhere`: this tab takes over when that one closes); "Satori's
  database can't be opened" (`damaged`: DuckDB's words, "Set aside and start
  again", Reload); "Satori could not start" (`fatal`: the error, Reload).
- **Six tabs** once set up: on a phone a bar at the bottom with Game, Home
  (in the middle) and Menu (`tab-menu`, three lines) that lists Models,
  Streams, Market, Wallet and Settings above it
  (`tab-menu-list`; closes on a choice, a tap outside or Escape); a top nav
  on a computer (1024 px and wider). The URL's `#game`, `#home`, `#models`
  (and `#models/<id>`), `#streams`, `#wallet`, `#settings` open them (a link
  or a reload keeps the tab). **Game** (`game-tab`, `data-play`: auto or manual):
  while the app plays automatically the game is greyed out under
  `play-switch` with **Play by hand** (`play-manual`); back to automatic in
  Settings › Satori contract predictions (`play-setting`, with
  `play-setting-auto` and `play-setting-manual`). The game (`game-board`): on top, while
  something is claimable, `game-claim-row` with `game-claimable` and `game-claim` (CLAIM, then CLAIMED); then one stream at a
  time, `game-balance` (the wallet's SATORI) above the star and `game-streak` above the value (the player's
  streak on its game, its number; `data-above` "true" at or past the game's turning point, green; else blue) with
  `game-streak-dots` (`data-n`: a dot per prediction), `game-name`
  with `game-star` (`aria-pressed`), `game-latest`,
  `game-chart`, `game-down` and `game-up` (a press picks and moves on; a
  swipe left skips, right goes back), `game-submit-early` (`data-open`) with
  `game-submit`; then `game-submit-screen` with `game-daily` (Satori Daily, a new
  tab), `game-calls` (each li: the name and an arrow, aria-label up or down),
  `game-send` (SUBMIT), `game-send-error`; a swipe right goes back, left on to
  the streams that aren't reward eligible; `game-sent` with `game-again-in` (the countdown), `game-remind` (Remind me) and `game-dismiss` (the streams again with
  `game-rest` where the buttons were);
  `game-nothing` with `game-again`. The alias plays when the wallet is
  staked with it, else the wallet (Unlock in place). With
  no route the app opens to the game if it was entered last and not left
  since (kept on this device, `satori-game`: `in`/`out`), else Home. The header has Lock and "Locks in 4 min" while
  unlocked, and "Update ready, reload" when a new version waits; on Home a
  share icon (`share`: the invite link, "Link copied" without a share
  sheet; shared from the Game tab it ends in `#game`, so it opens the game); everywhere a sun or moon (`theme-toggle`: to Light in dark, to Dark
  in light, as Settings → Appearance).
- **Home** answers "is my neuron predicting every day on its own, and is
  anything broken?" at a glance (`health()`'s object, drawn): the hero (an
  icon and a colour: sky green at rest, regular green while working, vivid
  while it must stay open, amber for warn, red for bad; the title, one line
  saying the step while it works, and quiet notes of an address change in
  the last 24 h), at most one action card (its words and one button that
  does the thing or goes there, amber or red for a problem, sky for advice;
  when it needs the wallet the passphrase is asked in place), the last 14
  days (30 on a computer, with a legend), the **Service**, **Contract**
  and **Network** chips (each opens its card under them and
  glows while its channel talks), the wallet's SATORI, then the claimable
  rewards with Claim (two cards). On a computer it is a dashboard: also the first
  8 streams (latest, forecast 24 h, model, a trend line) with a link to all,
  the wallet (claimable, the wallet, the alias's gas in days) and the
  activity feed (open; a tap away on a phone). Above Activity, **How
  Satori Works** (folded; `how`): "What is Satori?", then five pictures,
  each with a sentence (the app: streams in, predictions out; the network of
  apps; the contract scoring and paying; sharing; each day: open the app, or
  make predictions in the game).
- **Models** (docs/design/models.md): on top the engine's status: *Working*
  (the step, Home's words), *Resting* ("Trained 2 h ago · next run in 9 h"),
  *No models yet*, or *Needs a look* (amber: the engine itself failed); the
  models by kind ("84 models · 81 bvar · 3 naive") and against no change (a
  bar with its legend, "Beats no change on 24 of 84 · ties 40 · worse 19",
  the median model). Then three filter toggles, **Network**, **Contract**,
  **Relays**, each with its count, all on at each visit (a tap turns one off
  or on; the last on stays on), and Sort (Quality, Name; kept on this
  device). Each model row: its quality in words in its colour ("7% better",
  "Same as no change", "12% worse", "Not scored yet"), the stream it
  predicts ("publishes x_pred" for a Relays model), its kind, "reads +eth
  +gold" (its inputs by influence), now → the forecast with ↑ ↓ →, and where
  it goes as tags ("Service", "Contract", "Network"). A tap opens the
  drill-in: **In** (each input's share), **Model** (plain lines; Details: λ1,
  λ2, mutations, coefficients, the fade weight, the errors; Retrain for a
  Network model), **Out** (each output: the forecast, the latest value, a
  chart of recent history with the forecast to scale, "12 h" and "24 h"
  marks, How it did (the last outcomes as a line and what it forecast for
  each, dashed, as the Prediction Streams chart; until two have come due,
  "It shows once two of its forecasts have come due (1 so far) …"), and
  where it went); "← Models" goes back.
- **Streams**, every card folded until tapped: **Network Streams** (one
  line, "Sent 82 predictions Oct 24, 20:18, all accepted · next Oct 25,
  07:18", red when it fails, and Refresh (a poll now); a wallet mismatch if
  any; under its closed Details: Registered, Last poll, Next poll, Last
  submission, Pending, History; then each stream on one line, its latest
  value (and time, on a computer), its forecast "In 24 h", Sent or Pending;
  a tap on the name opens it in place under the row: its trend, "In 12 h",
  the model with its companions, "bvar · +eth +gold", in words, and its
  latest predictions; no URL: that is Settings');
  **Network Streams** (opening it discovers: a search box and the
  first 50 matches, each with one button on its right: Predict (follows it
  and predicts it: `subscribe(pubkey, stream, { predict: true })`) or Stop
  predicting (unfollows it: `unsubscribe`); a stream for sale shows

  **Published Network Streams** (each subscribed stream: latest value and

  **Prediction Streams** (every prediction stream on the relays, watched on
  its own: "Watching 112 prediction streams · 23 with a record", or the
  scan's step with a small turning ring, "Finding prediction streams ·
  checking signatures 400 of 1,061"; each row "Predictions for <source>",
  the predictor's short key or "you", the record pill as the Models tab's,

  it in place: the record in words, "Right way 15 of 20", a chart of the

  …. It counts only predictions this app received before the
  outcome.").
- **Wallet**: a card each (2026-10-28): Receive first, folded ("Show
  address and QR code": the wallet's address, Copy, its QR code), Base (the
  balances and Send), Preload gas, Staking (Stake or Unstake), Claimable (Claim), then
  Details (folded) and Wallets. Each action's passphrase prompt and result

  ("Staked SATORI can't be sent until you unstake", "SATORI can be sent

  in place, does it, then locks the wallet again), and the send form

- **Dev Fee** (in the menu only for a wallet in the dev fee's splitters):

  each payee a dot with its share and what it has not claimed; the wallet

  the most any transaction pays per gas; Save contract settings).
- Every screen and tab is built once and shown or hidden (the `hidden`
  attribute), so other screens' labels and other tabs' elements stay in the

  `wallet-row` with `data-id`, `wallet-address` (a tap copies it), its `.badge` "In use", `wallet-switch`,
  `wallet-remove`; `wallet-remove-confirm` with `wallet-remove-yes`;

  Setup: `other-wallets` with `wallet-back` (one per other wallet that was

  `wallet-connected` (a connected wallet's note).

  `nostr-pubkey`, `unlock`, `lock-wallet`, `backup-prompt`, `backup-key` (a

  shortened; `title` the whole one), `reward-whose` ("your wallet", "your

  `reward-read-error` with `reward-retry`, `reward-line`, `reward-error`,
  `reward-save`, `reward-clear`, `central-url`, `relay` with
  `relay-state`, `relay-for`, `relays-blocked`, `theme-<system|light|dark>`
  (`aria-pressed`), `storage`, `install`, `install-hint`,
  `runs-while-open`, `reminder` with `reminder-off`, `reminder-on` (`aria-pressed`) and `reminder-error`, `version`,
  `update-settings`. Setup: `setup-wait`,
  `runs-while-open`, `install-hint`, `set-aside-notice` (after a set-aside).
  Loading: `opening`. The inline prompt: `unlock-prompt` (`data-unlock-for`:
  `card`, `claim`, `wallet`). Elsewhere: `brand` (the enso and "Satori app": Home), `lock`, `lock-in`, `update`, `share`, `theme-toggle`,
  `finish`, `pass-note`, `notice` (a recovered WAL's, with Dismiss),
  `damaged-error`, `set-aside`, `fatal`.

## Base on the dev server: the local fork

The dev server's default Base RPC is `/rpc`, which it proxies to an anvil
fork of Base Sepolia on 127.0.0.1:8545 (the real D7 contracts; nothing goes
to a public chain). `node scripts/fork.mjs --help` lists:

- `start` / `stop` (anvil in the background, 2 s blocks; needs Foundry's
  anvil), every command taking `--port 8545`;
- `fund <0x…> [<0x…> …] [--eth 0.1] [--satori N]`: each address gets the ETH
  (0.1 by default) and, only with `--satori`, N SATORI from the deployer
  (~519 in all);
- `airdrop <0x…> <SATORI>`, `merkle <0x…> <SATORI>` (prints the proof a stub
  central serves), `advance [days]` (chain time; then `predictBase()`),
  `predict [up|down]` (moves the default stream), `stream [name]` (a game
  with no voting weight, which the batch leaves out), `grief <0x…>` (1 wei
  of SATORI with the bare gas estimate: a staked wallet goes out of sync,
  the token-hook bug).

Recipe: `fund <alias 0x…>` (gas for the batch) and
`fund <wallet 0x…> --satori 100` (gas and SATORI to stake), then
Unlock, `stake()`, `predictBase()`.

## From the Docker neuron (migrate in, never back)

The keys are Satori Lite's (github.com/SatoriNetwork/satori-lite and
github.com/SatoriNetwork/satorilib): one
32-byte secp256k1 secret per key = the private key = the BIP39 entropy of its
24 words. A Docker install moves here by Import (its wallet file with the
wallet password) or by Restore from words; its wallet is then stored in this
app's own format, and its alias and Nostr key derived from it. Nothing is written
back in Docker's formats. Central sees the same alias either way, and on
Base the same secrets give the same 0x addresses as the Docker neuron's
(`ethAddress`), so the stake and rewards follow the keys. Satori Lite is the
reference for what goes over the network: central's payload and Satori's
Nostr events carry Lite's fields (the text as JS writes it: numbers like
`100`, compact JSON, which central and satorilib parse; see
docs/design/central.md and nostr.md, "The protocol audit").

## Code

Repository: https://github.com/lastmeta/Satori (this app is the repository
root; branch `main`). Plain JavaScript ES modules, no
build step beyond Vite, MIT licensed.

- `src/main.js`: app wiring and `window.satori`; `src/config.js`: Settings'
  defaults, the dev server's or a build's, each replaced by a `VITE_*`
  variable at build time (`VITE_CENTRAL_URL`, `VITE_NOSTR_RELAYS`,
  `VITE_NOSTR_CENTRAL_WRITE`, `VITE_BASE_RPC`; `VITE_NOSTR_WSS`, the relays'
  wss stand-ins, is not a Settings value), and the version's shape; `src/util.js`: `serial()`
  (one at a time, in order), `isHttps()` and `isRelayUrl()`.
- `src/keys/`: the keys record (`index.js`: create, import, migrate, load,
  Unlock, the wallet for one use and Backup from the passphrase), the wallet
  encryption and the passphrase rule (`wallet.js`), a key's words, public
  key, Base address and signatures (`keys.js`), Docker's files read for
  import and migration (`docker.js`), the wallet locking on its own
  (`autolock.js`).
- `src/central/`: central's API (register, observations, login, predictions
  batch); `login.js`: central's login signature, EIP-191 by the alias.
- `src/db/`: DuckDB-WASM on OPFS, schema migrations (each marked additive
  or not), small async API; every commit checkpointed; `recover.js` sets
  aside a WAL an older version left, and a database file that won't open
  when the person asks.
- `src/engine/`: `forecast(points, { step, horizon }) → { model, t1, t2, value,
  horizon, phi?, weight? } | null`, pure: `step` is the bucket in seconds (12 h
  by default; a relay stream's cadence), `horizon` how far ahead `value` is
  (two steps by default; a forecast is one cadence ahead: 24 h for central,
  where value = t2; one cadence for a relay stream; max(24 h, cadence) on
  Base); t1 and t2 are one and two steps ahead; `{ weight }` forces the fade.
  `bvar.js`: the Bayesian VAR(1) of a target and its companions, its backtest
  and fallbacks, `influence()`; `evolve.js`: `runModels({ fresh, histories, specs, seed })`,
  each target's alias-seeded spec, one mutation per poll, the forecasts;
  `explainForecast` and `explainModel`: the same with what the Models tab
  shows; `retrain.js`: Retrain's search (a hill-climb on the older backtest
  origins, one look at the last two weeks).
- `src/nostr/`: NIP-01 events, their verification and the Nostr key over
  `@noble/curves` (`event.js`), Satori's events and parsing (`satori.js`),
  one relay over a WebSocket with reconnect (`relay.js`).
- `src/traffic.js`: `emit(channel)` on every request and answer (central's
  fetch, Base's RPC transport, each relay message) and `subscribe(fn)`:
  Home's glow (`src/ui/glow.js`) and `lastTraffic`.
- `src/neuron/`: register, the cycle (poll → store → history → forecast →
  submit), `history.js` (central's history for new streams), central's status, the schedule (`schedule.js`, shared with Base, and
  the catch-up pass), the one-tab lock (a queued Web Lock: the next tab takes over); `nostr.js`: relays,
  discover (signature-checked), subscribe, intake → `_pred`, reconcile, the daily prune, the scan for prediction streams and the intake's routing; `records.js`: the track record (which prediction streams are watched, the follow filters, the verified-order scoring, `records()`); `quality.js`: the mark against no change the Models tab and the records share; `base.js`: the daily batch and its schedule, stake, claims,
  sends, the Base settings; `activity.js`: the activity log (sessions,
  cycles, checks, publishes; 90 days); `health.js`: Home's answer from it,
  pure (`health()`), with its tone; `reward.js`: the reward address
  (checked, read, set or cleared); `work.js`: what it is doing now
  (`health().work`); `models.js`: the Models tab's data (`models()`,
  `model(id)`), pure but for the drill-in's reads; `train.js`: the training
  pass; `retrain.js`: Retrain as the app runs it (one at a time, kept with
  the spec, paused for a poll, resumed on open).
- `src/chain/`: Base over viem: `config.js` (the app's addresses, central's
  checked against them; the RPC), `abi.js`, `index.js` (`createChain`:
  status multicall, stake, the batch's pieces, claims, sends; the max fee on
  every transaction; CCIP-read off).
- `src/ui/`: ArrowJS: `view.js` (the shell, the tabs, Setup and the screens
  before Home), `home.js`, `models.js` (the Models tab; its words and chart
  in `drill.js`, pure), `streams.js`, `wallet.js`, `settings.js`,
  `parts.js` (the inline Unlock, shared pieces), `state.js`, `format.js`,
  `glow.js` (the chips' traffic glow), `hold.js` (the pace of the hero's
  steps), `theme.js` (Appearance;
  `public/theme.js` applies it before the first paint); `src/style.css` (the
  tokens: light, dark by the system, dark when chosen).
- `src/pwa/`: the installed app: `sw.js` (the service worker; a build writes
  it to `dist/sw.js` with the files to precache, `vite.config.js`),
  `index.js` (register it in a build once the database is open, Update,
  Install, persistent storage) and `platform.js` (how a browser without the
  install prompt adds Satori);
  `public/manifest.webmanifest` and the icons.
- `csp.js`: the CSP, a build's and the dev server's (which adds `ws:`).
  `deploy/`: the static image (nginx serving `dist/` behind central's
  nginx-proxy, which terminates TLS): `Dockerfile`, `nginx.conf` (the CSP,
  nosniff and HSTS on every response, cache headers, the SPA fallback) and
  `build.env` (the deployment's `VITE_*`); `scripts/deploy-image.sh` builds
  and checks `satori-neuron:<git sha>`.
- `public/llms.txt` (this file) and `public/llms-changelog.txt` (what
  changed, newest first).
- `docs/design/`: what is built and why (`OVERVIEW.md`, `health.md` (Home's
  rules: thresholds and the action priority; `home-mockup.html` the approved
  design), `models.md` (the Models tab: quality, influence, the drill-in),
  `keys.md`,
  `central.md` with Satori Lite's file:line references, `engine.md` with
  namaste_club's, the deviations and the backtest numbers, `nostr.md` with
  Lite's and satorilib's, `base.md` with Lite's, the dapp's and the
  contracts', `storage.md`: tables, migrations, meta keys, the checkpoint rule and recovery, `pwa.md`: the
  installed app, `deploy.md`: the image and the build variables); `docs/plans/`:
  the roadmap and what is left of each part; `docs/issues/`: open issues
  outside this repo; `docs/inbox/QUESTIONS.md`: open questions for the
  owner.
- `scripts/`: parity-vector generators run against satorilib and
  namaste_club (Python; `bvar_parity.py` for bvar), and
  `profile_fixtures.mjs` (the keys each earlier version stored); `backtest.mjs`
  (node, read only: bar1, persistence and simulated bvar neurons);
  `test-relay.mjs` (an in-memory Nostr relay: `node scripts/test-relay.mjs
  7778`) and `provider.mjs` (a throwaway stream provider for a test relay);
  `fork.mjs` (the local fork of Base Sepolia, above); `deploy-image.sh` (the
  deploy image).
- `test/`: fixtures (parity vectors) and test doubles (a fake D7 behind
  JSON-RPC, an in-memory DuckDB); `e2e/`: Playwright specs and their stub
  central (`stub.js`).
- Tests: `npm test` (vitest), `npm run e2e` (Playwright, Chrome, a stub
  central, two test relays, a fake chain behind `/rpc`), `npm run e2e:pwa`
  (a build on `vite preview` :5181: the manifest, the service worker,
  offline, Update, one neuron), `npm run e2e:deploy` (the deploy image at
  `DEPLOY_URL`: headers on every response, then the app in a fresh profile).

## Contribute

Pull requests are welcome at https://github.com/lastmeta/Satori. Keep changes
small, tested (vitest / Playwright) and in plain JS; follow the patterns of the
Docker neuron (Satori Lite) and satorilib; update `docs/design/`, this file
and `llms-changelog.txt` with what you change.
